method.method_draft: First describe the image contents: a central atom is connected by drawn lines to R, upper O⁻, lower O, and H; the lower O is also connected to Cl; curved arrows are present but are not bonds. Count all drawn bonds, then remove any bond with H as an endpoint. The drawn bonds are central–R, central–O⁻, central–O, central–H, and O–Cl. Excluding central–H leaves 4 bonds.
